author: Sumit999210

title: WOW!!
body:
This app is beyond amazing!
Features that blew me away: 
1. Each category is customised according to the needs of that category. For example, to track your weight it has graphs which shows your progress. 
2. You can customise the reminders according to your needs and can also set multiple reminders like 8 reminders to drink water distributed throughout the day (you can add how many ever you like). 
3. You can set goal streaks. For example, if you want to keep 30 days streak of studying, unless you complete the task it will not count it as a day. It’ll remind you the next day to complete even the previous day’s tasks.

No other habit tracker apps have so many features that too for free! I wanted to support them by paying for the premium version but it’s out of my budget. :(

title: Love the concept (but buggy)
body:
Good app - just what I was looking for. 

I liked ...
- The dashboard + tracker approach. So big thumbs up to the team on this 👍
- The different "templates" of tracking 

I hated ...
- The current version is simply annoyingly buggy esp. when creating milestones. Hop this is fixed in the next update.
- Docked a star for this else this would have been a 5/5

I'd like to see ... 
- app look & feel is good but it def. has potential to be great
- minor ease of usability improvements, again w.r.t milestones (edit, move them around, insert etc) cos milestones change & get refined as more info. comes in.
- oh and yea a widget :D this looks like something I could use on a daily basis
